title: Four stages of the opening
description: Lift the left foot, step into the open stance, lift both arms, then press both hands down.
provenance: Four stages selected from the two user-provided recordings; not four different tai chi forms.

clips.title: Lift the left foot
clips.description: Begin with feet together. Follow the instructor as the left foot lifts and begins to move outward.
clips.sourceFile: 太极拳入门_起势完整教学_5分17秒.mp4
clips.selectionReason: The visible left-foot lifting phase immediately before the step opens; full-body frontal view.
clips.provenance: User-provided prerecorded instructor video; actual MediaPipe reference inference runs in the browser.

clips.title: Step out to the left
clips.description: Begin with your left foot lifted as shown. Lower it to the side and settle into the open stance.
clips.sourceFile: 太极拳入门_起势完整教学_5分17秒.mp4
clips.selectionReason: The consecutive outward foot placement and settling phase, ending before the arms rise.
clips.provenance: User-provided prerecorded instructor video; actual MediaPipe reference inference runs in the browser.

clips.title: Lift both arms forward
clips.description: Begin in the open stance with arms lowered. Lift both arms forward with the instructor.
clips.sourceFile: 太极拳最简入门_起势示范节选.mp4
clips.selectionReason: One visible transition from arms lowered to arms raised, after the stance opens. Crop isolates the central instructor and retains the whole body. Played at half the source speed for a four-second learning attempt.
clips.provenance: User-provided prerecorded instructor video; actual MediaPipe reference inference runs in the browser.

clips.title: Press both hands down
clips.description: Begin with both arms raised. Follow both hands downward toward the waist while the knees soften.
clips.sourceFile: 太极拳入门_起势完整教学_5分17秒.mp4
clips.selectionReason: The complete visible hand-lowering phase. Palm orientation is not scored by the pose matcher.
clips.provenance: User-provided prerecorded instructor video; actual MediaPipe reference inference runs in the browser.
